videos.title: 🎬 Video URLs or IDs
videos.description: Watch URLs, youtu.be links, Shorts, live or embed URLs, or bare 11-character video IDs. Playlist and channel URLs pasted here are expanded too.

channels.title: 📺 Channels or playlists
channels.description: Channel URLs or @handles (latest videos; add /shorts or /streams to the URL for those tabs) and playlist URLs.

searchTerms.title: 🔎 Search terms
searchTerms.description: YouTube search queries. Top video results are scraped, great for finding outliers in a niche.

maxVideosPerSource.title: Max videos per channel / playlist / search
maxVideosPerSource.description: How many videos to take from each channel, playlist or search term.

maxResults.title: Max results in total (optional)
maxResults.description: Hard cap on the number of videos scraped (and charged) in this run.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy (datacenter) is used by default.

residentialFallback.title: Residential proxy fallback
residentialFallback.description: Retry blocked requests through residential proxy (no extra cost to you).
